title: Eric Bauza, who voiced Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and dozens of cartoon characters, dies at 46
text:
Eric Bauza, who voiced Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and dozens of cartoon characters, dies at 46 - ABC7 Los Angeles 
 24/7 Live Los Angeles Orange County Inland Empire Ventura County California Arts & Entertainment 
 Eric Bauza, who voiced Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and dozens of cartoon characters, dies at 46 
 By abc7.com staff Monday, October 26, 2026 5:33AM 
 Stream Southern California's News Leader and Original Shows 24/7 Prolific voice actor Eric Bauza, who was the modern voice of Bugs Bunny and other beloved cartoon characters, has died at 46.
 His family announced the news in a brief statement on Instagram.
 Bauza was best known for voicing several iconic Looney Tunes characters, including Bugs Bunny, Porky Pig, Daffy Duck and Tweety Bird.
 In addition to his work with Looney Tunes, Bauza voiced dozens of other animated characters throughout his career.

 His credits included Puss in Boots in "The Adventures of Puss in Boots," Baby Fozzie Bear in "Muppet Babies" and Luke Skywalker in various Star Wars animated projects.
 No additional details were immediately provided.
